# `jouet wind plan`

- **Usage:** `jouet wind plan [FLAGS]`

Find idle Codex sessions in opted-in project roots for scheduled review

This is a read-only plan: it does not run a model, record a review, or mark sessions reviewed. Roots are explicit; repeat --root for more than one. Older sessions come first, with projects interleaved.

## Flags
- **`--root <PATH>`** — Directory containing projects to consider; repeatable
- **`--limit <LIMIT>`** — Maximum candidates to return (default 10, maximum 100)
- **`--idle <IDLE>`** — How long a transcript must be idle (default 15m)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
